Double Shot.name: Double Shot
Double Shot.effect: Deal light Gun damage to 1 foe 2 times.

Dream Needle.name: Dream Needle
Dream Needle.effect: Deal light Gun damage and inflict Sleep (medium odds) to 1 foe.

One-shot Kill.name: One-shot Kill
One-shot Kill.effect: Deal severe Gun damage to 1 foe. High critical rate.

Riot Gun.name: Riot Gun
Riot Gun.effect: Deal severe Gun damage to all foes.

Snap.name: Snap
Snap.effect: Deal medium Gun damage to 1 foe.

Triple Down.name: Triple Down
Triple Down.effect: Deal light Gun damage to all foes 3 times.
